what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Our own email connector: one gateway touches Gmail, a twin in a vault, signed lanes, policies at five altitudes.
sections.para: Because the usual connectors cannot enforce anything.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: The mess; one gateway; the twin; many people one inbox; signed reads; five altitudes; the CRM first; the features.

sections.label: Why not the usual connector
sections.line: Usual connectors: no enforcement, no policies, everything allowed or a click per action, no context.

sections.label: One gateway, a twin, many hands
sections.line: One gateway holds the token; the mailbox becomes files in a vault; lanes carry proposals, approvals, reads.
sections.para: An air gap between reading and sending.

sections.label: Four flows
sections.line: Connect by tier, receive by watch and history, work together on the twin, send through approval and policy.

sections.label: Signed, even when you read
sections.line: Proposals, approvals, sends and even reads are signed, ordered on append lanes, not a commit per click.
sections.para: A trail of attention as well as action.

sections.label: Behaviour policies at five altitudes
sections.line: OAuth grant, token holder, per-agent rights, what an email may be, who approves.
sections.para: The fourth altitude is the new one.

sections.label: The features to build
sections.line: Fifteen features: shared inbox with roles, inbound firewall, signed mail, vault links, approvals anywhere, a calendar twin.
sections.para: The brief, not the first slice.

sections.label: Where it lives
sections.line: An AgentiCCells cell, an OAuth app under RiskMandate's Google project, in browser, iPhone CRM and Claude.

sections.label: What Google requires
sections.line: Send is sensitive; read is restricted and needs an assessment if stored on servers; 100 test users before.
sections.para: Start in testing with our own inboxes.

sections.label: A build order for the team
sections.line: A build order: our inboxes, lanes and signatures, the email policy, the CRM component, automated sends, the cell.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A brief and an architecture, not built; Google's rules to confirm; signed reads record opening, not understanding.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Google's Gmail API documentation, integrators' guides, and earlier articles.
